title: Debentures and notes: Improving disclosure for retail investors
subject: This guide provides guidelines for issuers on disclosure to retail investors for unlisted debentures, secured notes, and unsecured notes, aiming to help investors understand and assess these products while maintaining flexibility in public fundraising.
background: The guide is issued under the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) and is intended for issuers and others involved in issuing mortgage debentures, debentures, secured notes, and unsecured notes. It sets out ASIC's expectations for disclosure to retail investors and guidance on how these instruments may be described.
ruling: ASIC expects issuers to provide clear and balanced disclosure that helps retail investors understand the key features and risks of debentures and notes. The guide sets out specific disclosure benchmarks and principles for describing these products, including when they can be called 'secured notes'. ASIC also provides guidance on advertising and continuous disclosure obligations. The regulatory approach emphasises investor protection while preserving the efficiency of the fundraising process.
